brief:
Two African countries are in discussions with Israel about participating in what has been described as a "Gaza force," according to Ma'an Wire. The scope and nature of the proposed military arrangement remain undisclosed at this stage.

The reported engagement marks a potential shift in regional military alignments regarding operations in Gaza. Neither the identities of the African nations nor the specifics of their potential role have been made public.
title: Two African nations explore joining Israel's Gaza force
